search.label: Search query
sort.label: Sort
empty.initial.title: Search your vault
empty.initial.body: Type a word or part of a word. Sift searches titles, headings, tags and note text.
empty.initial.hint: Use "quotes" for a phrase, a minus sign to exclude a word, and path: title: tag: to limit a term.
empty.indexing.title: Building the index
empty.indexing.body: Sift is reading your notes. Results appear as soon as this is done.
empty.no-results.title: No matches
empty.no-results.hint: Try a shorter term, remove a filter, or switch on similar matching.
empty.query-error.title: Check the search terms
empty.query-error.body: Part of the query could not be read. Sift searched the part it understood.
empty.index-error.title: The index could not be built
empty.index-error.body: Sift could not finish reading your notes, so results are missing.
empty.index-error.hint: Rebuild the index in the Sift settings, then search again.
error.unclosed-quote: A quotation mark was never closed
error.dangling-operator: An operator without a search term was ignored
error.unknown-field: Unknown field prefix, searched as plain text
error.query-too-long: The query is too long and was cut off
error.indexFailed: The index could not be built
error.openFailed: The note could not be opened
index.statusFailed: The index could not be built
index.rebuild.desc: Reads every note again. Needed after a change to the excluded folders or to the created date field.
settings.defaultSort.name: Default sort order
settings.defaultSort.desc: Sort order a newly opened search starts with.
settings.snippetCount.name: Snippets per result
settings.snippetCount.desc: How many excerpts a result card shows, 1 to 3.
settings.createdField.name: Created date field
settings.createdField.desc: Frontmatter key read as the creation date. The file date is used when the key is missing.
settings.excludedFolders.name: Excluded folders
settings.excludedFolders.desc: One folder per line. These folders are never indexed and never searched.
settings.language.name: Language
settings.fuzzyByDefault.name: Similar matching by default
settings.fuzzyByDefault.desc: Starts every search with the similar toggle switched on.
settings.includeSubfolders.name: Include subfolders by default
settings.includeSubfolders.desc: Starts every search with the subfolders of the chosen folder included.
settings.maxResults.name: Maximum results
settings.maxResults.desc: Upper limit of results shown per search, between 20 and 1000.
